fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (TSLA)'s average analyst rating reached 3.67 on a 1-5 scale, the highest level since early 2023, and ARK Invest reaffirmed a price target of $4,400 per share by 2031.
fields.summary_ko.1: ARK expects robotaxis to account for approximately 80% of enterprise value by 2031, and projects that the Optimus humanoid robot, with approximately 1 million units, will contribute about 14% to enterprise value.
